verdict.rationale: Viam documents access control as part of Fleet Management, and its fleet API lets you manage permissions and authorization across organizations, locations and machines. Machines can also enforce per-resource, per-method restrictions through `user_permissions` in their config, which gives fine-grained control over who can command each robot. missing for 10: explicit documentation of named roles (e.g., owner/operator/viewer) that separate command, configure and view rights; detail on how role assignment scopes to individual machines; independent or hands-on corroboration.
